ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform using drone imagery and custom classification models to detect early-stage crop diseases and nutrient deficiencies in Indian farming regions.
ideas.title: AgriVision AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact local agricultural problem solving with proven computer vision techniques similar to winning biomechanics and satellite monitoring projects.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI voice bot providing preventive health awareness, real-time outbreak alerts, and vaccination schedules tailored for rural and semi-urban communities in India.
ideas.title: GramSwasthya AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets social welfare and health education, matching the winning strategy of accessible, multilingual community care platforms.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent platform for supply chain emission tracking and carbon credit calculation tailored to MSMEs in developing industrial corridors.
ideas.title: EcoTrace Bharat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with green tech and multi-agent coordination patterns that impress judges looking for scalable, climate-conscious enterprise solutions.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-detection and graph intelligence platform to flag suspicious digital transaction patterns for regional cooperative banks and fintech startups.
ideas.title: FinShield AML India

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and meal planning assistant that constructs affordable, culturally appropriate daily meal recommendations based on regional Indian dietary patterns and local market prices.
ideas.title: NutriBharat AI
